## Official Brand Identity & Assets
All verified vector marks, BIMI email indicators, retina favicons, and lockups are hosted at https://vibtools.github.io/vibtools-brand-assets/ and stored in https://github.com/vibtools/vibtools-brand-assets:

- **Master Vector Emblem (SVG):** `/logos/logo-master.svg` (1254×1254, SVG Tiny 1.2 PS compliant, 1:1 square)
- **Primary Horizontal Lockup - Dark Theme:** `/logos/vibtools-horizontal-dark.png` (2400×630)
- **Primary Horizontal Lockup - Light Theme:** `/logos/vibtools-horizontal-light.png` (2400×630)

### 2. BIMI Email Specification (RFC 9495)
- **Production BIMI SVG:** `/bimi/logo.svg` (SVG Tiny 1.2 PS, baseProfile="tiny-ps", version="1.2", viewBox="0 0 1254 1254")
- **Master Source BIMI SVG:** `/bimi/logo-master-source.svg`
- **DNS TXT Record:** `default._bimi.vib.tools` -> `v=BIMI1; l=https://vib.tools/bimi/logo.svg; a=https://vib.tools/bimi/certificate.pem`
- **Supported Inboxes:** Gmail / Google Workspace, Apple Mail (macOS & iOS), Yahoo Mail, Fastmail.

## Product Catalog & Ecosystem
1. **Portable Account Browser:** Portable multi-account Chromium browser for Windows desktop. Isolated profiles for email, social, and web apps. (Available, Open Source)
2. **ContextVault:** Portable ChatGPT conversation archive tool for Windows desktop. Saves RAG-ready archives with integrity verification. (Available, Open Source)
3. **MailStack:** Self-hosted business mail server and shared team inbox. Open-source receive-only email infrastructure. (Available, Open Source)
4. **Licora:** Central software license management system. Software licensing, product access, device limits, API validation, and audit. (Available, Open Source)
5. **Vib ID Account Portal:** Central web account portal for Vib Tools services (profile, security, 2FA, sessions). (Available)
6. **Vib Project Template:** Technology-neutral repository structure with boundaries for source, tests, documentation, and assets. (Available, Open Source)
7. **Invio:** Provider-based invoice automation desktop application for Windows. (Active development)
8. **VibraPilot:** Browser automation desktop application with managed sessions and Windows runtime controls. (Active development, Open Source)
9. **InvoiceRouter for n8n:** n8n automation node for provider invoice lifecycles, account allocation, and retries. (Active development, Open Source)
10. **Vibrix:** Python/PySide6 desktop UI framework for scalable, production-oriented desktop software. (Early development, Open Source)
